name_ar: متوسط السرعة على الطرق وقت الذروة
purpose_en: Shows whether peak-hour travel is getting slower.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل أصبحت الحركة وقت الذروة أبطأ.
formula: mean(avg_speed_kmh) over registered counters, working days, peak-hour window

purpose_en: Counts how long roads are slow, not just how slow.
purpose_ar: يقيس مدة الازدحام وليس شدته فقط.
formula: count(congested sensor-hours on the day) ÷ number of reporting counters

purpose_en: Tells planners whether parking supply matches demand.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل تكفي المواقف الطلب.
formula: Σ occupied ÷ Σ capacity, 08:00–18:59 on working days, valid rows only (0 ≤ occupied ≤ capacity)

purpose_en: Measures the reliability residents feel at the stop.
purpose_ar: يقيس انتظام الحافلات كما يشعر به الراكب.
formula: Σ (on_time_pct × boardings) ÷ Σ boardings

purpose_en: Shows how much residents use public transport as the district grows.
purpose_ar: يبيّن مدى استخدام السكان للنقل العام مع نمو الحي.
formula: Σ boardings on the day ÷ district population × 1,000 (working days)

purpose_en: Tracks household demand fairly as the population grows.
purpose_ar: يتابع الطلب المنزلي بعدل مع نمو السكان.
formula: Σ kWh of metered residential buildings ÷ residents served (see definitions)

purpose_en: Shows how much of the street network is dark because of faults.
purpose_ar: يبيّن نسبة الإنارة المعطلة في الشوارع.
formula: light-days with status = fault ÷ all light-days with a status

purpose_en: Warns early when the network is close to its limit.
purpose_ar: ينبّه مبكرًا عندما تقترب الشبكة من حدّها.
formula: max over the day of Σ hourly kWh across metered buildings (cleaned)
notes: Lite meters 80 buildings; on the full edition (327 buildings) re-baseline before use.

purpose_en: Shows the share of lights that actually worked each night (faults and unexplained switch-offs).
purpose_ar: يبيّن نسبة أعمدة الإنارة التي عملت فعلًا كل ليلة.
formula: light-days with status = on ÷ light-days with a status

purpose_en: Shows whether residents get water at usable pressure.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل تصل المياه للسكان بضغط مناسب.
formula: readings with 3.0 ≤ pressure_bar ≤ 5.0 ÷ valid readings (registered points, non-missing)

purpose_en: Flags when network flow grows faster than metered use — leaks or unbilled use.
purpose_ar: ينبّه عندما يزيد التدفق في الشبكة عن الاستهلاك المقاس.
formula: (Σ network flow_lps × 900 s ÷ 1000 → m³) ÷ Σ metered m³, indexed so the baseline = 100
notes: The kit's flow points are not zone inlet meters, so use this only as an index against its own baseline, never as a loss percentage.

purpose_en: Shows how often drinking-water samples meet all three training limits.
purpose_ar: يبيّن نسبة العينات المطابقة للحدود الثلاثة.
formula: station-days with 0.2 ≤ chlorine ≤ 1.0 mg/L and turbidity ≤ 1.0 NTU and 6.5 ≤ pH ≤ 8.5 ÷ station-days sampled
notes: Training limits; check against the Egyptian drinking-water standard before quoting [VERIFY].

purpose_en: Tracks household water demand fairly as the population grows.
purpose_ar: يتابع الطلب المنزلي على المياه مع نمو السكان.
formula: Σ m³ of metered residential buildings × 1000 ÷ residents served

purpose_en: Shows how often residents meet a full bin.
purpose_ar: يبيّن كم مرة يجد السكان الحاوية ممتلئة.
formula: bin-hours with fill_pct ≥ 95 ÷ valid bin-hours (duplicates removed)

purpose_en: Shows whether trucks travel full or half-empty.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل تسير الشاحنات ممتلئة أم نصف فارغة.
formula: Σ tonnes ÷ number of trips

purpose_en: Shows whether bins are emptied at the right time — too low wastes trips, too high means overflow.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل تُفرغ الحاويات في الوقت المناسب.
formula: mean fill_pct in the last reading before each emptying (a drop of ≥ 40 points between consecutive hours)

purpose_en: Tracks how much waste the district produces per person.
purpose_ar: يتابع كمية المخلفات لكل فرد.
formula: Σ tonnes × 1000 ÷ district population
notes: Smart bins only; household collection outside the bin network is not in the kit.

purpose_en: Measures how fast help reaches the scene; the median is not distorted by rare long cases.
purpose_ar: يقيس سرعة وصول المساعدة.
formula: median(response_min) of incidents by event date

purpose_en: Shows how much of the district the CCTV network can actually see.
purpose_ar: يبيّن ما تستطيع الكاميرات رؤيته فعلًا.
formula: mean(uptime_pct) across cameras

name_en: Share of incidents detected by CCTV
purpose_en: Diagnostic: when it falls, check camera coverage before concluding that safety improved.
purpose_ar: مؤشر تشخيصي: إذا انخفض فافحص تغطية الكاميرات أولًا.
formula: incidents with source = CCTV ÷ all incidents

purpose_en: Compares serious incidents fairly as the population grows.
purpose_ar: يقارن الحوادث الجسيمة بعدل مع نمو السكان.
formula: incidents with severity 1–2 in the week ÷ district population × 10,000

purpose_en: Shows whether maintenance keeps its promised times.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل تلتزم الصيانة بالأزمنة المتفق عليها.
formula: closed work orders with (closed_at − opened_at) ≤ sla_hours ÷ closed work orders, by close date

purpose_en: Shows whether public buildings are comfortable when people are inside.
purpose_ar: يبيّن هل المباني العامة مريحة أثناء وجود الناس.
formula: occupied building-hours with 22.0 ≤ indoor_temp_c ≤ 26.0 ÷ occupied building-hours

name_ar: طاقة التكييف لكل شخص في الساعة
purpose_en: Shows cooling efficiency, fairly across busy and quiet buildings.
purpose_ar: يبيّن كفاءة التكييف مقارنةً بعدد الموجودين.
formula: Σ hvac_kw ÷ Σ occupancy_count over occupied building-hours (1 kW for 1 hour = 1 kWh)

purpose_en: Shows how much overdue maintenance is waiting at the end of each day.
purpose_ar: يبيّن حجم الصيانة المتأخرة في نهاية كل يوم.
formula: open work orders at 23:59 whose age > sla_hours

purpose_en: Counts days when fine particles are high enough to matter for health.
purpose_ar: يحسب الأيام التي ترتفع فيها الجسيمات الدقيقة.
formula: station-days with daily mean pm25 > 50 µg/m³ ÷ station-days with data
theme: Environment and climate change · U4SSC: Environment (air quality)
notes: Training threshold. Compare with the WHO guideline and the Egyptian ambient air standard before quoting [VERIFY].

purpose_en: Counts dust-storm days, when outdoor work and traffic are affected.
purpose_ar: يحسب أيام العواصف الترابية.
formula: days with district mean pm10 > 150 µg/m³
theme: Environment and climate change · U4SSC: Environment (air quality)

purpose_en: Shows how often night-time noise disturbs residents.
purpose_ar: يبيّن كم مرة تزعج الضوضاء السكان ليلًا.
formula: sensor-hours 22:00–06:59 with laeq_db > 55 ÷ night sensor-hours
theme: Environment and climate change · U4SSC: Environment (noise)

purpose_en: A KPI is only as good as its data: shows how much of the expected air data arrived.
purpose_ar: يبيّن نسبة بيانات الهواء التي وصلت فعلًا.
formula: non-missing pm10 readings ÷ expected station-hours
theme: Environment and climate change · ISO 37122 (smart environment)

purpose_en: Measures how long residents wait for a fix.
purpose_ar: يقيس مدة انتظار المواطن للحل.
formula: median(closed_at − created_at) of requests closed in the period, times normalised to local time

purpose_en: Captures how residents judge the service, not just its speed.
purpose_ar: يقيس تقييم السكان للخدمة.
formula: mean(satisfaction_1_5) of answered surveys

purpose_en: Tracks the shift to the citizen app; more requests through the app are not more problems.
purpose_ar: يتابع التحول إلى تطبيق المواطنين.
formula: requests with channel = app ÷ all requests
notes: The citizen app does not exist in the baseline period, so the baseline is 0%.

purpose_en: Normalises demand for services by population. Read it together with CIT-03: an easier channel raises it.
purpose_ar: يقيس الطلب على الخدمات نسبةً للسكان.
formula: requests in the week ÷ district population × 1,000

purpose_en: Measures how long residents wait for permits, connections and certificates.
purpose_ar: يقيس زمن إنجاز المعاملات الحكومية.
formula: Σ (avg_processing_days × transactions) ÷ Σ transactions

purpose_en: Shows how often the shift needs a supervisor or pillar owner.
purpose_ar: يبيّن كم مرة تحتاج الوردية إلى التصعيد.
formula: tickets with escalated = True ÷ all tickets

purpose_en: Measures how fast the centre resolves the tickets that matter most.
purpose_ar: يقيس سرعة حل التذاكر الأهم.
formula: median(resolved_at − created_at) of tickets with severity 1–2
